setup.description: Interactive project setup — detects your project, configures metaswarm, writes project-local files

start.description: Begin tracked work on a task — primes context, guides scoping, picks right process level

start-task.description: Begin tracked work on a task with complexity assessment

prime.description: Load relevant knowledge from the BEADS knowledge base before starting work

review-design.description: Architecture-focused design review (single architect-agent in this POC; full 5-agent gate not yet registered)

design-review-gate.description: Automatic review gate that runs after brainstorming completes - spawns PM, Architect, Designer, Security, and CTO agents in parallel

plan-review-gate.description: Adversarial plan review with 3 independent reviewers (Feasibility, Completeness, Scope & Alignment)

orchestrated-execution.description: 4-phase execution loop for work units - IMPLEMENT, VALIDATE, ADVERSARIAL REVIEW, COMMIT

self-reflect.description: Semantic summarization and context compaction via BEADS

handoff.description: Create structured handoff document for next agent/session

pr-shepherd.description: Monitor a PR through to merge - handles reviews, CI, conflicts

brainstorm.description: Structured brainstorming with design review gate trigger

update.description: Update metaswarm to latest version in this project

status.description: Run diagnostic checks on project health

create-issue.description: Create a well-structured GitHub Issue with metaswarm context

handle-pr-comments.description: Process and respond to PR review comments systematically

external-tools-health.description: Check health and availability of external AI tools (Codex, Gemini)

issue-orchestrator.description: Main coordinator per issue — spawns sub-agents, runs 4-phase execution loop

architect-agent.description: Reviews technical architecture and creates implementation plans

product-manager-agent.description: Defines product requirements, prioritizes features, owns product vision

researcher-agent.description: Deep research across sources, synthesizes findings into reports

cto-agent.description: Strategic technical decisions, architecture approval, risk assessment

security-design-agent.description: Threat modeling, security architecture review, secure design patterns

code-review-agent.description: Adversarial code review focusing on correctness, security, maintainability

sre-agent.description: Reliability, observability, incident response, capacity planning

metrics-agent.description: Defines and tracks SLIs/SLOs, builds dashboards, analyzes system metrics

slack-coordinator-agent.description: Manages Slack communications, incident channels, stakeholder updates

coder-agent.description: Implements code changes following TDD, writes tests first

pr-shepherd-agent.description: Shepherds PRs through review, CI, merge — handles comments, conflicts

release-engineer-agent.description: Manages releases, versioning, changelogs, deployment pipelines

customer-service-agent.description: Handles user feedback, support tickets, feature requests triage

test-automator-agent.description: Writes and maintains test suites, enforces coverage thresholds

security-auditor-agent.description: Security audits, vulnerability scanning, compliance checks

swarm-coordinator-agent.description: Orchestrates multi-agent swarms for complex parallel work

designer-agent.description: UX/UI design, design systems, accessibility, user research

knowledge-curator-agent.description: Maintains BEADS knowledge base — patterns, decisions, gotchas, facts
